_meta: Audit record for the dynamic-chain families. The actual parameters are produced by mmd_physics_retune.py (transplant/analogy) and corrected by fix_rigid_frames.py + fix_initial_overlaps.py; this file documents the family map, exclusions and reference evidence for verification.

front_hair.strategy: transplant (byte-exact bones in reference, ref group 4, mask 0xFFEF)

tail.strategy: transplant, depth-resampled (ref chain has 9 weiba + 4 weipd bodies, span differs; ref ±10deg, ld/ad 1.0, mass 0.1->0.01, mask 0xF800 = collides groups 11-15 only)

back_hair.bones: Bone_hair003..037 (32, three chains rooted at Bone_hair003/014/023)
back_hair.strategy: analogy <- reference 后发 back hair (126 bodies, mass 30->0.1 root-heavy taper, ld 0.4->1.0, ad 1.0, all joints locked - the reference stiff-shell idiom)

bow.strategy: analogy <- reference hudiejie butterfly (mass 1.0, ld/ad 1.0, locked joints; ref group 3 mask 0xFFF7)

ribbon.bones: bone_ribbon00..05 (6, anchored under 首 via the static 'position' bone)

breast.strategy: explicit MMD-standard (mass 0.4, damp 0.85/0.90, ±7/5/7 deg, spring_rot 40; reference has 胸上/胸下 group 14 but on different bones)

excluded_from_physics.Bn_L/R_jiao01..04: reference has the identical bones (byte-exact) with NO rigid bodies - horns are rigid by design
excluded_from_physics.Bone_hair, Bone_hair01: hair-crown bases carrying 1970/2538 verts of scalp geometry; kept static so the crown cannot detach from the skull, and so branch tips are not handed mid-curve masses (P11 in branch form)
excluded_from_physics.position: static ribbon-knot anchor at the neck (78 verts)

root_anchor_check: every chain root's nearest generator collider is also the collider bound to the root bone's hierarchical ancestor (P23 satisfied without a skirt-style override): hair/bow/liuhai/daimao -> 体_頭, ribbon -> 体_首, weiba -> 体_骨盤 (bone 下半身), xiong -> 体_上胸 (bone 上半身2).
